items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: I got acquainted with Fess Moneta... we would play duets together. And that's how I come to be friendly with him.

ctx.x: Remember the method book you used?

Auburn? The Auburn Method. Oh, I went through the Auburn. Through the Auburn Method. And then after that, I got acquainted with Fess Moneta, and I started going over by his house, and he was giving a few ideas too, you know, on the trumpet. And we would play duets together. And that's how I come to be friendly with him.

What was that one job you told me once about Fess when you were playing, that old man Albert Blinney and all of us, at some party they were at? Oh, and he was out there, Saturday night, and caught in the trumpet.
